# UI assets

`book-open.svg`, `pencil-simple.svg`, `plus.svg`, and `x.svg` are from the light weight of `@phosphor-icons/core` 2.1.1. Their fill was set to the application's warm muted ink. The MIT license is included in `phosphor-LICENSE`. These are local static assets and require no package installation at runtime.

`washi-tape.png` is a transparent PNG generated with the built-in image_gen tool, 2172 × 724 pixels. CSS scales the original; Canvas samples the tape strip from its transparent padding. Loading failure omits this optional decoration without preventing PNG export.

Generation prompt: Create exactly one horizontal strip of pale dusty rose semi-transparent washi tape, color #F1D8DF, approximately 4:1. Fine realistic paper fibers, subtle irregular torn short edges, quiet low contrast, flat top-down view, genuinely transparent background. No text, logos, pattern, doodles, outlines, shadows, curled edges, or surrounding objects.
